ocr.notes: Mostly readable, but the opening line and the weight sentence are garbled in the transcript; the image is clear.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Training at the Buckeye House near Cincinnati

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reprinted a Cincinnati Enquirer item describing crowds visiting Tom Allen at the Buckeye House, where he was training under Sherman Thurston and weighed about 165 pounds.

metadata.notes: The page head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, May 26, 1869'. The St. Louis Republic name dates from 1888.

facts.fact: Allen trained for the McCoole fight at the Buckeye House near Cincinnati under trainer Sherman Thurston, weighing about 165 pounds

notes: Clipped from the Cincinnati Enquirer of the 24th. The same Enquirer item appears in the Daily Democrat the same day (319). The current title is ungrammatical.
